algorithm: PPO with LLM-authored (GPT-4) evolutionary reward search
hand: Shadow Hand (also Allegro Hand; bimanual pairs of Shadow Hands for Dexterity tasks)
success_criterion: number of consecutive successes where current success is 1[rot_dist < 0.1] (AllegroHand/ShadowHand)
headline_value: EUREKA exceeds or matches human-level reward on all 9 Isaac tasks and 15/20 Dexterity tasks (Sec. 4.3)
paper_code_mismatch: The released repo's default eureka/cfg/config.yaml ships iteration:1, sample:3 (a fast-test default), not the paper's reported experimental configuration of N=5 iterations × K=16 samples × 5 independent runs, and LLM-generated reward code itself is never checked into the repo (written at runtime to a gitignored outputs/ directory).
note_gaps: Pen-spinning, EUREKA's flagship dexterity result, has no quantitative success-rate/cycle-count table in the parse, only qualitative claims and a training-curve figure; per-task Dexterity/Isaac breakdowns are given only as a figure (Fig. 4), not a table; the preliminary real-robot demo (App. F) is a locomotion-hopping task, not a hand task; reward_terms/reward_term_names are not applicable in the usual sense since EUREKA generates a different reward per task/iteration rather than reporting one fixed reward.
mismatch_review: R3 adversarial review: the repo README documents the paper's defaults; the cited config block is a fast-test preset
